description: Breaking Fantasy Football player news along with the impact for fantasy managers

items.author: Diego Sandoval
items.desc: Coby Bryant is expected to miss the next eight to 10 weeks after suffering a hyperextended knee, a bone bruise and a small fracture at Monday's practice.
items.impact: Bryant was carted off the field on Monday, and it has now been revealed that he will miss at least the first part of the 2026 season. The 27-year-old cornerback joined the Bears this off-season, and the Chicago secondary is now left with a big hole to fill before training camp comes to an end.
items.title: Coby Bryant (knee) expected to miss 8-10 weeks

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: De'Zhaun Stribling is still not practicing on Monday due to a hamstring injury.
items.impact: Stribling missed practice over the weekend. He remains day-to-day.
items.title: De'Zhaun Stribling (hamstring) not practicing Monday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Mike Evans did not practice on Monday due to a quad injury.
items.impact: Evans is the latest wide receiver for San Francisco to suffer an injury. It doesn't appear to be anything serious long-term. He is day-to-day.
items.title: Mike Evans (quad) misses practice Monday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Kaelon Black missed practice on Monday with an adductor injury.
items.impact: With Jordan James sidelined with a fractured rib, Black was seeing more opportunity to compete for the RB2 role in the 49ers backfield. He is day-to-day for now.
items.title: Kaelon Black (adductor) not practicing Monday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Panthers coach Dave Canales said Kenny Pickett will start the Hall of Fame game on Thursday against the Cardinals.
items.impact: Pickett is expected to be the backup behind Bryce Young this season. He should see plenty of snaps in the preseason.
items.title: Kenny Pickett to start Hall of Fame game for Panthers

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.desc: Bobby Brown III has been activated off of the NFI list and will practice Monday.
items.impact: Brown was originally placed on NFI due to a hamstring injury he suffered in the offseason. The former Rams starter will add some depth to the Panthers defensive rotation and veteran presence.
items.title: Bobby Brown III activated off of NFI list, will practice Monday

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.desc: Nick Muse has been signed by the Detroit Lions. In a corresponding move, the team released WR Tarik Black.
items.impact: The 27 year old tight end spent his first three years in Minnesota and since has bounced around the league, taking stops with Arizona, the Rams, and the Jets among others. He will try to work his way onto the roster, but it could prove a tall task with the amount of talent the Lions already possess.
items.title: Nick Muse signed by Detroit Lions

items.author: Garrett Ball
items.desc: Kyle Monangai is dealing with a soft tissue injury, per HC Ben Johnson. Johnson told reporters the team is taking it "day-by-day" and that his absence should be "on the shorter side."
items.impact: This is good news for Monangai, who is looking to build off of a successful rookie season as the RB2 for the Bears. Hopefully Johnson's assessment is true, and the young back can get back on the field soon.
items.title: Kyle Monangai dealing with soft tissue injury

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Alim McNeill was back at practice at Lions training camp on Sunday.
items.impact: McNeill was evaluated on Saturday. He was back on the field one day later.
items.title: Alim McNeill (neck) returns to practice Sunday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Benjamin Morrison has still been absent from practice due to a hamstring injury.
items.impact: Buccaneers coach Todd Bowles said Morrison's lingering hamstring injury is not the same leg as the one sidelining him last year. He remains without a clear timetable to return.
items.title: Benjamin Morrison continuing to battle hamstring injury

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Derrick Moore left Sunday's practice early with a groin injury.
items.impact: Moore will continue to be further evaluated heading into Monday.
items.title: Derrick Moore battling groin injury

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Miles Kitselman left Sunday's practice with a leg injury.
items.impact: Kitselman was competing for a depth role in the tight end room for Detroit.
items.title: Miles Kitselman dealing with leg injury

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Vikings waived rookie running back Kejon Owens.
items.impact: Owens opened camp with a non-football illness designation. He will figure to seek another opportunity.
items.title: Kejon Owens waived by Vikings

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Vikings signed CB Jarod Washington.
items.impact: Washington went undrafted out of South Carolina State. He will compete for a depth role in the secondary for Minnesota.
items.title: Jarod Washington signs with Vikings

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Kool-Aid McKinstry was back at practice at Saints training camp on Sunday.
items.impact: McKinstry was dealing with a minor ankle injury. He was still held out of team drills on Sunday.
items.title: Kool-Aid McKinstry (ankle) returns to practice Sunday

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Titans hosted DB Wande Owens for a workout on Sunday.
items.impact: Owens was recently released by the Bills.
items.title: Wande Owens works out for Titans

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Packers activated CB Kamal Hadden from the PUP list.
items.impact: Hadden has been cleared to return to practice. He was back on the field on Sunday.
items.title: Kamal Hadden (leg/ankle) activated from PUP list

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Eagles waived Ta'Quon Graham.
items.impact: Graham will figure to seek another opportunity during training camp.
items.title: Ta'Quon Graham waived by Eagles

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: Ja'Qurious Conley has cleared waivers to become a free agent.
items.impact: Conley was waived by the Buccaneers with a non-football-injury designation. He will seek another opportunity.
items.title: Ja'Qurious Conley clears waivers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The 49ers hosted veteran EDGE Ogbo Okoronkwo for a workout.
items.impact: Okoronkwo played for the Eagles last season. He is competing to earn a spot in training camp with San Francisco.
items.title: Ogbo Okoronkwo works out for 49ers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Titans signed DB Derrick Canteen.
items.impact: Canteen spent last season on the 49ers practice squad. He will compete for a depth role in the secondary for Tennessee.
items.title: Derrick Canteen signs with Titans

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The 49ers waived/injured DL Mikail Kamara.
items.impact: Kamara was carted off the field from practice over the weekend. It is a tough break for him.
items.title: Mikail Kamara waived by 49ers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The 49ers signed DL Titus Leo to a one-year contract.
items.impact: Leo spent last season on the Eagles practice squad. He will compete for a depth role on the 49ers defensive line.
items.title: Titus Leo signs with 49ers

items.author: Ari Koslow
items.desc: The Commanders released CB Tre Hawkins III.
items.impact: Hawkins will figure to seek another opportunity during training camp.
items.title: Tre Hawkins III released by Commanders
